text_block_list.text:
After training with Hokko Tarumae. As usual,
we were 
discussing our schedule of races and locodol
activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
I'm thinking of holding some events other
than 
street performances.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I would like to consider ways to convey the
charm of 
Tomakomai and attract more customers.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
First we need to get the word out to a lot
of people…… 
what do you think Trainer?

An event that can raise awareness.
It is essential that the 
event has the ability to attract a large
number of visitors. 
Speaking of events that can attract a lot
of people…
choice_data_list: How about going to a music festival!
How about we go to a music festival!

text_block_list.text:
The more the population of the audience grows,
the more 
people will be interested in Hokko
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
…… The music festival that trainer is talking
about is a big 
event with a lot of famous artists and idols,
right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I think it is tough.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To be on such a stage,
it is essential to have a proven 
track record and popularity in the
entertainment industry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's hard for a local locodol with no track
record and no 
credibility to be allowed to appear on the
stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
even if we were able to participate in a
festival, 
the festival-goers are there to listen to
the artists' songs.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It is difficult to get such people interested
in Tomakomai. 
That is why you have to have an influence
backed by a proven 
track record and popularity.

I was naive.
How to increase the number of visitors to 
Tomakomai,
a good idea is not going to come so
easily.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm…… I think I'll leave it at that for 
today and reconsider. Thanks for taking 
the time to discuss this with me!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An event that attracts visitors and gets
them interested in 
Tomakomai.…… I knew it would be hard to come
up with―.

Good! With this dance performance,
you're going 
to win the world,
aren't you? You'll be on 
TV and become a big star in no time!

No, no, no,
the TV industry is not that easy.
You need not 
only talent, but also luck and hard work.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Yes, yes. The industry is very tough―)

Eeeeh～ Don't be so serious there!
You're such a downer! 
You're always like that!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Festival-goers come to hear the artists
sing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It is difficult to get such people interested
in Tomakomai. 
That is why you have to have an influence
backed by a proven 
track record and popularity.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that one earlier was also…… too serious
……?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way…… trainer,
make a troubled face. I think she 
was hurt by my seriousness, too―

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (The trainer liked Tomakomai.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(They are very supportive of my desire to
make 
Tomakomai a better place and said they
would 
work with me to make it happen. ……)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ― and yet I'm so rude ……!

On my way back to my room,
I saw Hokko Tarumae standing 
there look like she is waititng someone.
I walked up to her 
to see what was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh…… um, trainer.…… Uh, that,
good work today……!

I was just about to think a plan for an
event to be hosted 
in regards to the plan I mentioned earlier.
Since I'm here, 
I'll let her know about it.
choice_data_list: Tarumae, about what we talk about ...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ……! I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I am always grateful for the support of the
street 
live activities,
and that alone is enough for me……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll be fine!
It's enough if we can continue to do this 
kind of steady street live performance!
Excuse me!

…… Indeed,
organizing event is hard.
Does it mean that live 
street activity is the most solid path?

As she said,
I would like to support her steady
activities 
and learn more about community
development.
